items.source: Converts the given time unit into a DensifyOperation.DensifyUnit. Supported units are: days, hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds.
items.translation: 将给定的时间单位转换为DensifyOperation.DensifyUnit。支持的时间单位包括：天、小时、分钟、秒和毫秒。

items.source: Converts the given chrono unit into a DensifyOperation.DensifyUnit. Supported units are: years, weeks, months, days, hours, minutes, seconds, and millis.
items.translation: 将给定的时间单位转换为DensifyOperation.DensifyUnit。支持的时间单位包括：年、周、月、日、小时、分钟、秒和毫秒。

items.source: timeUnit - the time unit to convert, must not be null.
items.translation: timeUnit - 要转换的时间单位，不能为 null。

items.source: chronoUnit - the chrono unit to convert, must not be null.
items.translation: chronoUnit - 要转换的时区单位，不能为 null。
